The clinical presentation of a prodromal viral illness followed by a facial "slapped cheek" rash and a subsequent lacy, reticular rash on the trunk and extremities is classic for Erythema Infectiosum (Fifth Disease), caused by Parvovirus B19.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Erythema Infectiosum (Fifth Disease)
